name: Diyarbakır Fortress and Hevsel Gardens Cultural Landscape
description: Diyarbakır, in southeastern Türkiye, is encircled by 5.8 kilometres of dark basalt walls, studded with towers, gates and carved inscriptions, that rise above the Tigris. Inside stands the İçkale citadel on the ancient Amida Mound. Below the walls, the 700-hectare Hevsel Gardens still bring green fields to the riverbank, and the medieval Ten-Eyed Bridge crosses the river nearby.
